title: Verify UI context owner lifecycle with unavailable data
changes: Add a focused current UI-context lifecycle test using an owned selected dataset copy and synthetic state files.
validation: The e127-d126 Wine test confirms failed reattachment after the selected copy becomes unavailable, exact Load/Undo/Restart states, retained owner and 220 typed bytes after each operation; restoring the copy allows a fresh machine to reconstruct an owner and read all 220 bytes.

Current-source Windows release test compilation passes with selected source and executable hashes; guarded inputs pass and synthetic state files plus successful scratch are removed. Evidence: target/validation/units/rvr20-ui-context-build-ji43yrp5/ and target/validation/units/rvr20-ui-context-e127-h1n2fo7g/.
Consumed successful build scratch was retired after host open-file, lease and inventory checks; evidence and receipt remain in target/validation/units/rvr20-ui-context-build-ji43yrp5/.
limitations: Synthetic scope does not establish all ordinary UI consumers, backup restoration, native Windows, Linux, USA or performance.
